headline: European Supermarket Refrigeration Systems Targeted in Recent Cyberattacks
summary: Recent cyberattacks have targeted financial institutions, government ministries, and the refrigeration systems of hundreds of supermarkets across Europe.
why: Cybersecurity incidents targeting retail supply chains and critical infrastructure can disrupt commercial operations and impose substantial remediation costs.

impacts.name: European Retail Sector
impacts.why: Supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe were impacted by cyberattacks.
